purpose: Visual concept only; not production UI or a runtime sprite sheet
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished landscape concept presentation for the existing mobile fantasy tactical guild-management game Rising Guildmaster. Show THREE complete portrait mobile game screens side by side on a simple dark navy background, no device hardware. Title above: "RISING GUILDMASTER" and small subtitle "Pixel RPG · Visual concept".
Reference image 1 is the authoritative existing HERO PORTRAIT ART STYLE: preserve its mature finely shaded pixel-art aesthetic, warm amber light, navy shadows, steel and brass palette. Reference image 2 is the existing guild dashboard only for gameplay context; transform its visual presentation substantially.
All three screens use cohesive handmade pixel art with crisp visible pixel clusters, restrained bronze corner ornaments, oak panels, dark slate readable content areas, strong hierarchy and generous text size. This should look like an actual playable premium pixel RPG, not a web dashboard. No gradients/glass UI, tiny paragraphs, photorealism, excessive ornament, or generic emoji.
LEFT screen: "GUILD HALL", slim top resources showing "DAY 42" and coin "6,080". Main upper 55% is a beautiful richly detailed top-down pixel-art guild interior with fireplace, long war table with map, trophy wall, wooden floors, banners and a few tiny adventurer sprites. Clearly readable small location plaques "War Table", "Tavern", "Training". Lower area one quest card "CURRENT ORDER" / "Clear the Cellar" with a small creature icon and large gold "PREPARE PARTY" button. Bottom five icon navigation entries "Guild", "Quests", "World", "Heroes", "Inventory".
MIDDLE screen: "TAVERN · RECRUITMENT". Atmospheric tavern scene as header; dominant large framed bust of the female warrior from reference 1, faithful face and steel armor rendered in the same style. Under portrait: "Elara" / "Human · Warrior" / "FRONTLINE". Compact readable contract strip "Fee 120 G" / "Pay 18 G / week". One small instruction "Review a hero, then sign a contract." Two clear buttons "INSPECT" and gold "SIGN CONTRACT". Small second candidate portrait teaser below. Comparison is optional only, no required compare UI or step. Same bottom navigation.
RIGHT screen: "CELLAR SKIRMISH", "ROUND 2". Upper two thirds an overhead square-grid pixel dungeon battlefield, four distinguishable hero sprites and three rat/goblin enemies, stone walls, barrels, torchlight, clear movement tiles in muted blue, target red outline, readable HP bars. Bottom action tray with female warrior portrait, "Elara · Warrior", "HP 84 / 100", large distinct sword/shield/charge skill icons and gold "END TURN". Tactical clarity and large touch targets.
Keep screen proportions plausible for phones, all screen bottoms visible. Environment art and character faces must harmonize with reference 1. Legible exact labels, sparse copy. This is a concept image, not a collage of existing screenshots.
